note: Synthetic responses for the packaged Linear profile. Every Linear read is a POST GraphQL query, so these fixtures are the data half of the standard GraphQL envelope. Every value is synthetic, no credential appears here, and nothing has been sent to a live account.

authentication.documented_types: An API key or an OAuth access token, both sent as a bearer token.

RATELIMITED.note: Rate limiting is reported as HTTP 400 with the RATELIMITED code inside the errors array, so the status alone is not sufficient.

INVALID_QUERY.note: A query can fail inside the errors array while the status stays 200, which is why the recipe declares an errors contract.

partial_data.note: A GraphQL query can partially succeed with HTTP 200, returning data while including errors for the fields that failed.

documented_limits: Request rate per hour: 2,500 for an API key, 5,000 for an OAuth app, and 600 per IP unauthenticated.
Hourly complexity budget: 3,000,000 points for an API key, 2,000,000 for an OAuth app, and 100,000 unauthenticated.
A single query is limited to 10,000 complexity points at any time.
Default pagination returns up to 50 records.
pagination_note: The packaged tools are deliberately unpaginated: a fixed document cannot bind a returned cursor, so team listings stay out until a reviewed paged document exists.
notes: Linear publishes no example response for the viewer query, so the fixture mirrors the documented selection set inside the standard GraphQL envelope.
No field nullability is documented for the viewer object, so the label pointer is reviewed rather than declared safe.
